title: Tactical decision making for autonomous trucks by deep reinforcement learning with total cost of operation based reward
core_idea: Develop a deep reinforcement learning framework for tactical decision making in autonomous trucks (adaptive cruise control and lane changes) that separates high-level decision-making (RL agent) from low-level physical-model-based controllers, and optimizes performance using a realistic, multi-objective reward based on total cost of operation (TCOP) via weighting, normalization, and curriculum learning techniques.
tldr: Create an RL-based high-level tactical decision system for highway autonomous trucks that uses a TCOP-based multi-objective reward and separates RL from low-level physical controllers to improve practical decision-making.
